cohort: The study included women who delivered in Croatia's largest University maternity hospital, with data collected for 259 out of initially 372 enrolled women.
finding: Parity and depressed mood immediately after delivery are associated with EBF six to eight weeks after delivery, with higher EPDS scores linked to lower odds for EBF and multiparous women without depressive symptomatology being more prone to EBF.
followup_time: six to nine weeks after delivery
